entities.title: Hand of the Isle
entities.summary: An original god game for desktop, made in Godot 4.4: the player reshapes an island and calls down powers so their followers outgrow a rival deity's.
entities.purpose: One scene (main.tscn) runs Main, which builds everything else in code: the terrain, the simulation, the rival, the camera and the interface. There are no external assets. README.md gives the rules, the controls and the command-line test switches.
boundaries: It is not a browser game: it has no package.json, Worker, web export or high-score table, so the CI and Deploy workflows (.github/scripts/changed-games.sh) skip it.
It needs no sign-in and makes no network calls.
